title: PhonePe payment successful but merchant says not received - what to do?
title_hindi: PhonePe में पैसे कट गए पर दुकानदार को नहीं मिले - क्या करें?
author: Ramesh Sharma, Jaipur
description: Paid ₹350 at grocery shop. Money deducted from SBI account, green tick appeared on PhonePe, but merchant soundbox did not ring.

answers.author: KaamKa Dost Assistant
answers.text:
1. Take a screenshot of the green tick page showing the 12-digit UTR number.
2. In 95% of cases, the merchant's soundbox was on mute or delayed by 2 minutes. Ask the merchant to check their merchant app history.
3. Do NOT pay cash immediately. If merchant forces, show the UTR number. If money doesn't settle within 24-48 hours, RBI rules mandate automatic reversal to your bank.

title: Received SMS: 'Electricity will be disconnected at 9:30 PM due to unpaid bill'
title_hindi: बिजली कटने का SMS आया है - क्या यह फ्रॉड है?
author: Pooja Verma, Lucknow
description: Got an SMS with a personal 10-digit mobile number asking to call urgently or click a link to update electricity bill. My bill was already paid on Bijli app.

answers.author: Cyber Safety Guide
answers.text: 🚨 100% FRAUD / SCAM! Electricity boards never send SMS from personal 10-digit mobile numbers or WhatsApp. They only send from official alphanumeric sender IDs (like UPPCL, DHBVN, BESCOM). Never call that number or install any app (AnyDesk/TeamViewer). Block the number immediately.

title: How to clean WhatsApp storage when phone says 98% full?
title_hindi: WhatsApp स्टोरेज कैसे खाली करें बिना फोटो डिलीट किए?
author: Deepak Patel, Ahmedabad
description: My Samsung phone is lagging terribly. In Settings > Storage, WhatsApp is taking 24 GB.

answers.author: Tech Dost
answers.text: Open WhatsApp > Settings > Storage and Data > Manage Storage. Here you will see 'Files larger than 5 MB' and 'Forwarded many times'. Delete those forward videos first! They take 80% of space and you will not lose personal family photos.
